text: @philmingdao/anno-dsh-native（DSH 插件，浏览器编辑界面）：为 HTML 页面提供本地审阅、编辑和标注流程。插件在 DSH 主机配置中注册 html_review_* 工具并启动内置审阅服务；用户可创建会话，在浏览器直接修改文字、调整格式、添加元素或区域评注与页注，再提交给当前 agent 处理。会话与修订状态保存在本机目录，默认位于 ~/.anno；无需额外 API Key 或外部服务。

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native (DSH plugin): review HTML in a browser, edit text and formatting, add comments and page notes, then hand revisions to the current agent. It registers html_review_* tools and runs a review server; sessions stay on this machine. No key or external service required.
我想在浏览器里直接审阅 HTML 页面，改完文字和格式后交给 agent 继续处理。
能不能给网页元素加批注和页面备注，再把这些修改交回当前 DSH 会话？
I need a browser based way to mark up an HTML draft and hand the requested changes back to my agent.
@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native 的功能「浏览器审阅与标注」：通过 html_review_start_session 打开 HTML 预览，可改文字、调格式，并添加元素或区域评注及页面备注；修订保存在当前会话。
@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native 的功能「Agent 修订交接」：提交浏览器修订后，插件保存草稿和请求并通知当前 agent；agent 可读取会话与批注，完成后登记独立 HTML 输出。

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Anno for DeepSeek Harness (native)：`@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native` is a **native** DeepSeek Harness plugin for [Anno](https://github.com/philmingdao/anno) — a local-first HTML review, editing, and annotation workspace for coding agents.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Anno for DeepSeek Harness (native)：Unlike [`@philmingdao/anno-dsh`](https://github.com/philmingdao/anno/tree/main/adapters/dsh), which bridges the MCP server through the official DSH MCP client, this package runs Anno **in-process**: the local review HTTP server, the on-disk session store, and the six `html_review_*` model tools all live inside the Harness process. There is no MCP layer, no child `npx` process, and no separate server to launch.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · What it provides：- `html_review_start_session`
  - `html_review_get_session`
  - `html_review_claim_handoff`
  - `html_review_mark_handoff_sent`
  - `html_review_list_sessions`
  - `html_review_register_final`

- A `tool:anno` system-prompt section that teaches the agent the start → review → claim → resolve workflow.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`
- Node.js 22 or newer

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · or from a source checkout:：dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Then start Harness normally:

```sh
dsh web
```

The tools appear as `html_review_*` (no MCP namespace prefix). Because the row sits on the host plane, every agent on that profile shares one review server and one session store.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Source checkout：```sh
npm install
npm test
dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"
```

Use a temporary `--dsh-home` when testing without changing your normal profiles.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Use：Ask Harness to open or review an HTML file. It calls `html_review_start_session` with the absolute source path and opens the returned `review_url` for the user.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Use：When the user clicks **提交给 Agent** in the browser editor, the review server prepares the handoff and pushes it straight back into the originating agent conversation: the plugin captures the calling agent when the session is created and, on submission, queues an ordinary follow-up turn (`agent.followup`) carrying the full review — in-place text edits, format changes, element/area annotations, and page notes — so the agent claims the handoff immediately and resolves it into a verified standalone HTML file via `html_review_register_final`, without any manual polling.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Use：The receiving turn's prompt instructs the agent to call `html_review_claim_handoff` first (durable receipt), then `html_review_get_session` to reload the full session and apply the edits and annotations against the draft HTML, then `html_review_register_final`. The in-process push is best-effort: if the originating agent is no longer live, the handoff is still persisted on disk and the agent can claim it through the ordinary `html_review_*` tools.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Architecture：```text
DSH profile composition
  -> @philmingdao/anno-dsh-native  (cordis plugin + bundle patch)
    -> anno-core.js                (HTTP server + on-disk session/review/handoff store, node-only)
    -> index.js                    (registers html_review_* tools + tool:anno prompt section)

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Architecture：`lib/anno-core.js` is deliberately free of DSH imports and is unit-tested directly (`npm test`). It exposes an `onHandoff` hook (invoked by the HTTP `generate` endpoint with the full review payload) and a `hasHostTarget` predicate (reported as `has_host_target` on the session projection) so the host binding can deliver handoffs without the core depending on any host runtime.

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Architecture：`lib/index.js` is the thin Cordis binding that injects `tools`, `systemPrompt`, and `agents`, starts the server as a fiber-owned effect, and registers the tools using raw JSON-Schema definitions directly against the `tools` registry. It captures the calling agent on `html_review_start_session` and, through `onHandoff`, delivers the submission back as an `agent.followup` notice. It imports no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (or any other DSH package) — the follow-up user message is built from the same shape `createUserMessage` produces, using only `node:crypto` — so the package keeps zero external dependencies and loads from any location (including a `link:`-installed source checkout).

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Configuration：The `anno-native` row accepts:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `dsh` | Host kind stamped on session records. |
| `dataDir` | `$ANNO_DATA_DIR` or `~/.anno` | Root for persisted review sessions. |
| `assetsDir` | package `assets/` | Directory holding `editor.html` / `handoff.html`. |

@philmingdao/anno-dsh-native README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @philmingdao/anno-dsh-native
```

Existing review sessions under the data directory are left in place.
